comment: Files taken from the user's Asset Store packages in AssetDownloads by tools/import-assetstore.ps1. Only these are imported; the packages themselves never enter the project. 'select' is a regex over each item's path inside the package; 'strip' is removed from that path to form the output path. Textures become <name>_diff/_nor_gl/_arm JPGs at most 2K so the ThirdParty import rules apply unchanged.

packs.name: Essential Footsteps
packs.use: footsteps on wood (houses), concrete (cobbles and stone), dirt (streets and road) and leaves (forest ground)

packs.name: Terrain Textures Free (MicroVerse Extras)
packs.use: damp patchy grass for the village ground, overgrown grass for gardens, dead leaves under trees

packs.name: Saloon Interior (Quixel Megascans)
packs.use: worn rural props: cart wheel, chest, metal bucket, barrel, old chair, shelf, oil lamp, horseshoe over doors, family picture frames, ceiling beams, jug, stool, table
